title: Teo
text: Teo was excellent.  His knowledge of the local area was great.  We felt safe and  enjoyed our many stops along the way.  His driving was amazing in the traffic.  I appreciate his patience with us as we walked a good bit and our frequent stops.  He is just outstanding
author: 907lynnh

title: Best experience!
text: This was the best tour on our entire 12 day vacation! Alberto was charming, funny & informative.  We loved the beautiful sights, and the rain could not even dampen our spirits. So much fun!!
author: MaryAnn B

title: Fun day w Theo!
text: Theo was funny, knowledge, and attentive! The experience was incredibly interesting and enjoyable! I'd suggest him to all.
author: jadecelispiritualh

title: Great Tour!
text: Wonderful day touring Barcelona, Sagrada Familia and Montserrat.  Our tour guide, Teo was very knowledgeable and very entertaining!!  Really enjoyed the other couples sharing the tour with us and especially enjoyed Teo’s wit and sense of humor.  We learned a lot and laughed a lot!
author: L3341VXmarciah

title: Tour with Teo & Sangrada Familia/Montserrat
text: The views were amazing and i was able to take plenty of pics. Teo was informative and outgoing. Definitely recommend this tour and Teo.
author: oliviarV3499XH

title: Fantastic
text:

author: wendy865

title: Tour and Vicente was amazing 5 stars
text: Tour was with Vicente and Joaquin, who were absolutely fantastic, the tour was amazing, the Sagrada Familia is truly breathtaking but the best part of the tour by far was Vicente, he made you feel so welcome and was so nice, would really recommend this to anyone. Thank you Vicente from Charlie and Jas
author: cawoodward

title: Really good guide, amazing place.
text: We had trouble finding the group (my fault) but our guide, Jordi, was patient in finding us and basically unflappable. We did a small group tour - 5 of us - and we enjoyed it thoroughly. Jordi is knowledgeable and charming and I recommend him.
author: Viki_Y

title: Great tour for a small group
text:
The tour guide was extremely knowledgeable with regard to this church and its history.  We learned so much about its construction and the reasons for its design by 
Gaudi.  The church is stunning and all should go to see it once in their lifetime.
author: Diane_P

title: A must see church and a must do tour!!!
text: What an amazing site that combines religion, history, architecture, nature and the visual display of the Gaudi genius. Miguel was a phenomenal guide who expertly explained all the symbolism in the church. He was extremely friendly and professional and helpful. This is a must visit place to see and experience, especially with Miguel!! Highly recommend this tour!!
author: David_C
